Setup from an empty machine (Python environment, building or reusing the DSSAT engine, data locations,
timings on the reference machine) is in
[`docs/getting-started.md`](https://github.com/bennyistanto/xdssat/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md). This
page does not repeat it; it maps each step to its script and to the settings that change the result.

## Settings: where things live

Every setting of a run is in one experiment file (`configs/xdssat.yml`, or `--config <file>`), read and
checked by `src/config.py`. xdssat has no built-in folders: each computer sets its own in the `paths` section,
or with the environment variables below, which win over the file. The table is what `config.py` resolved when
the site data were exported.

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(settings, {header: {setting: "config.py name", variable: "Environment variable", value: "Value at export", from: "From"}, layout: "auto"})
```

| Variable | Changes |
|---|---|
| `XDSSAT_ENGINE` | Which `dscsm048` build runs, so which DSSAT version produces the results. Must be a short path outside OneDrive. |
| `XDSSAT_WORK` | Where the per-process run folders are made. Short path (the engine keeps paths in fixed 80-102 character buffers; `config.MAX_RUN_DIR_LEN` = 60). |
| `XDSSAT_AGERA5`, `XDSSAT_SOILGRIDS`, `XDSSAT_INPUTS`, `XDSSAT_BOUNDARIES` | Source data read by the preparation scripts. |
| `XDSSAT_CACHE` | Where every prepared input and run is written and read back. |
| `XDSSAT_CONFIG` | Which experiment file is read when no `--config` is given. |

## The steps

| # | Step | Script | Reads | Writes (under `XDSSAT_CACHE`) | Options that change process or output |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Check the setup | `check_setup.py` | config, engine | nothing | `--no-run` (skip the engine test) |
| 0 | Build the engine | `build_engine.py` | `dssat-csm-os` | engine folder + `BUILD_INFO.txt` | `--source`, `--clone --ref` (engine version), `--engine-dir` |
| 1 | Weather (case study) | `build_agera5_cache.py` | AgERA5 global netCDF | `agera5/idn/<VAR>/` int16, DSSAT units | `--vars`, `--years` |
| 1 | Weather (any source) | `prepare_weather.py` | daily or sub-daily netCDF, station or POWER files | `inputs/weather/<name>/` | section `prepare > weather`; `--inspect`, `--overwrite` |
| 2 | 100 m rasters (case study) | `prepare_rasters.py` | rice, MoA, AEZ, soil, admin2 polygons | `rasters/idn_*.tif` + class tables | `--layers` (which layers), `--adm2` (district boundaries), `--aoi` (test window) |
| 2 | Crop mask (any source) | `prepare_crop_mask.py` | land-cover, crop-share, crop-area or field map | `inputs/crop_mask/<name>/` | section `prepare > crop_mask`; `--inspect`, `--overwrite` |
| 2 | Water regime, region, zones (any source) | `prepare_layers.py` | class or share maps, rasters or polygons | `inputs/<kind>/<name>/` | sections `prepare > water_regime`, `region`, `zones`; `--kind`, `--inspect` |
| 3 | SoilGrids tiles | `fetch_soilgrids.py` | ISRIC server | tiles in `XDSSAT_SOILGRIDS` | `--aoi` (the area's land cells), `--props`, `--depths`, `--dry-run` |
| 4 | SoilGrids area cache (optional, faster) | `build_soilgrids_cache.py` | SoilGrids mirror | `soilgrids/<area>/*.tif` | `--aoi` |
| 5 | Soil profiles | `prepare_soils.py` | crop mask, weather grid, SoilGrids or your `.SOL` | `inputs/soil/<name>/` or `soils/<aoi>.SOL` | section `prepare > soil`; `--aoi`, `--weather`, `--crop-mask`, **`--no-soc-scale`** |
| 5 | Organic carbon factors | `fit_soc_scale.py` | WISE profiles (`WI.SOL`), SoilGrids | the `soc_scale` setting, printed | `--country`, `--bbox` |
| 6 | Template FileX | `make_templates.py` | `dssat-csm-data` IRMZ8601 | `templates/XDRI8601.RIX` | none; one treatment per cultivar, water level and N rate |
| 7 | Run | `run_aoi.py` | the prepared inputs named in the experiment file | `runs/<aoi>_<mode>_<y0>-<y1>[suffix]/` | `--config`, `--check`; see below |
| 8 | netCDF | `make_netcdf.py` (also called by `run_aoi.py`) | run folder | `<run>.nc` | `--out` |
| 9 | Observations | `fetch_bdsp.py`, `clean_bdsp.py` | BDSP portal | `obs/bdsp_rice_*_adm2.csv` + flags | `--boundary` (code moves) |
| 10 | Compare | `compare_districts.py`, `compare_bps.py` | run, obs, rasters | `checks/districts/`, `checks/bps/` | **`--moisture`** (GKG), `--min-ha` (districts kept) |
| 11 | Fit SLPF | `fit_slpf.py` | three or more runs differing only in SLPF, obs, rasters | `checks/districts/fit_slpf.json`, `fit_slpf_grid.csv`, `slpf_table.csv` (for `--slpf-table`) | **`--runs`** (the SLPF sweep), `--step` (grid step), `--moisture`, `--min-ha` |

::: {.source-note}
Compiled from the scripts' docstrings and their `--help` (below). Step order and timings:
`docs/getting-started.md`, section 6.
:::

### `run_aoi.py`: the options that change the simulation

Each option sets one setting of the experiment file for this run and wins over the file; the defaults are
those of `configs/rice-java.yml`.

| Option | Default | Effect on the run | Effect on the output |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--mode` | | `uniform` (15 Nov / 1 Apr), `by_zone` (one calendar per AEZ), `per_cell` (BMKG onset per cell) | planting dates; `onset.csv` or `zone_table.csv` |
| `--years FIRST LAST` | | agricultural years (1 Aug to 31 Jul) | `time` axis of the netCDF; folder name |
| `--onset-years` | `--years` | years in the onset median (`per_cell`) | planting dates |
| `--zone-table` | median onset per zone | `by_zone` calendar | planting dates |
| `--cultivar` | `IR 58` | `IR 58` (IB0012) or `IR 64` (IB0015): template treatment | folder suffix `_ir64...` |
| `--n` | 140 | 0 / 35 / 70 / 105 / 140 kg N as urea, 2/3 at 18 and 1/3 at 41 days after transplanting | folder suffix `_n...` |
| `--slpf` | profile value (1) | multiplies daily carbohydrate (`RI_Grosub.for:648-649`): level calibration | suffix `_slpf...`; netCDF attribute `soil_fertility_factor_SLPF` |
| `--slpf-rainfed` | same as `--slpf` | SLPF of rain-fed strata only; their cells get a copy of the soil profile (`XR...` IDs) with this value | suffix `_rf...`; netCDF attribute `soil_fertility_factor_SLPF_rainfed` |
| `--slpf-table` | none | CSV `iy, ix, water, slpf` (from `fit_slpf.py`): SLPF per stratum, rain-fed strata on `XR...` profile copies; replaces `--slpf` and `--slpf-rainfed` | suffix `_<table name>`; netCDF attribute `soil_fertility_factor_SLPF_table` |
| `--tcldf` | CUL value | cold sterility threshold of the cultivar, written into the run's own copy of `RICER048.CUL` (`src/genotype.py`) | suffix `_tcldf...` |
| `--sample N` | all cells | run only N cells, sampled by rice area | fewer strata |
| `--block` | 5 | agricultural years per batch | none (memory and progress only) |
| `--chunk-size` | 200 | treatments per FileX and engine process | none |
| `--workers` | 32 | engine processes in parallel | none (wall time only) |
| `--out` | `XDSSAT_CACHE/runs/...` | where the run is written | |

::: {.source-note}
Defaults from the argument parser of `scripts/run_aoi.py`; the current run used ${summary.current.workers}
workers and chunk size ${summary.current.chunk_size} (`run_info.json`). `--slpf` and `--tcldf` effects per
their `--help` text and `src/genotype.py`. The current run, ${summary.current_run}, was made with ${currentSettings}; the SLPF values come from
`fit_slpf.py` (step 11).

```{ojs}
currentSettings = summary.current.slpf_table && summary.current.slpf_table !== "None"
  ? `--slpf-table ${summary.current.slpf_table} --tcldf ${summary.current.tcldf}`
  : `--slpf ${summary.current.slpf} --slpf-rainfed ${summary.current.slpf_rainfed} --tcldf ${summary.current.tcldf}`
```
:::

### What the settings do to the results

Every run folder in the cache, as Java area-weighted yield per season year. Switch the system to see how mode,
the initial soil nitrogen correction, SLPF and TCLDF move the series.

```{ojs}
viewof rySys = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Wet, irrigated", "wet_irrigated"], ["Wet, rain-fed", "wet_rainfed"], ["Dry, irrigated", "dry_irrigated"]]), {value: "wet_irrigated", label: "System"})
viewof ryRuns = Inputs.checkbox(runs.map(d => d.run), {value: runs.map(d => d.run), label: "Runs"})
```

```{ojs}
withDownload(Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 900), height: 380, marginLeft: 55,
  x: {label: "Season year (1 Aug start)", tickFormat: d => String(d)},
  y: {label: "Java yield, kg/ha dry matter (production / harvested area)", grid: true},
  color: {legend: true, domain: runs.map(d => d.run)},
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(runYears.filter(d => d.system === rySys && ryRuns.includes(d.run)), {x: "season_year", y: "yield_kg_ha", stroke: "run", tip: true})
  ]
}), `xdssat-runs-${rySys}`)
```

```{ojs}
withDownload(Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 900), height: 60 + runs.length * 42, marginLeft: 300, marginRight: 20,
  x: {label: "Area-weighted yield over all years, kg/ha dry matter", grid: true},
  y: {axis: null},
  fy: {label: null, axis: "left"},
  color: {legend: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(runs.flatMap(r => ["wet_irrigated", "wet_rainfed", "dry_irrigated"].map(s => ({run: r.run, system: s, v: r[`yield_${s}`]}))).filter(d => d.v != null),
      {y: "system", fy: "run", x: "v", fill: "system", tip: true})
  ]
}), "xdssat-runs-yield-by-system")
```

::: {.source-note}
From each run's netCDF: `production.sum() / harvested_area.sum() * 1000` per system (and per season year in
the line chart). Runs made before the correction of the initial soil nitrogen are kept for comparison only.
:::

## Run outputs

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `experiment.yml` | the resolved settings of the folder; rerun it with `run_aoi.py --config <folder>/experiment.yml` |
| `strata.csv` | one row per weather cell and water regime, with crop ha and zone |
| `units.csv` | one row per simulated season (cell, regime, planting date, template treatment) |
| `summary.csv` | DSSAT seasonal summary joined to the units (`HWAH`, `MDAT`, `TMINA`, ...) |
| `failed.csv` | seasons the engine rejected, with its error message |
| `onset.csv` | `per_cell`: onset per cell (days after 1 Aug, date, years with an onset) |
| `zone_table.csv` | `by_zone`: the planting calendar of each zone |
| `run_info.json` | arguments, counts, timings, engine path |
| `<run>.nc` | CF-1.10 netCDF, `(system, time, lat, lon)`; layout on [How xdssat differs](gridding.qmd#cf-netcdf-output) |

## Command-line help of every script

The text below is each script's own `--help`, captured when the site data were exported, so it follows the
code.

```{ojs}
viewof cliPick = Inputs.select(Object.keys(cli), {value: "run_aoi", label: "Script"})
```

```{ojs}
cliText = cli[cliPick].text()
html`<pre class="cli-help">${cliText}</pre>`
```

## Tests

`python -m pytest tests`; tests marked `engine` run the real DSSAT executable and are skipped when it is
absent. The tests are in `tests/`, one file per module or topic.
